title: ui fighter display names (schema 1)
description: ui/data/fighter_names.json: the name a player sees for each roster id (lower case, as the sim spells it). A fighter with no row shows its own name. `names` maps a roster id (lower case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter) to its display name (a non-empty string of at most 24 characters, or a record {name, title, sigName}: name required, the others optional). Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

title.description: The full title shown under it (optional).

sigName.description: The name of the fighter's signature (optional).

anyOf.description: A fighter's row as a record: the name and, optionally, its title and signature name.

names.description: A roster id (lower case; both spellings of a fighter may have rows during the rename) to its display: a bare name string, or {name, title, sigName} (name required; title and sigName optional strings).
